messages:
lisa: heads up — deploybot flagged an embeddings quality regression after the EU cutover. some downstream rerank jobs returning lower scores, not a 5xx but clear metric drift. details below.

deploybot: :warning: MODEL-QUALITY-REGRESSION
metric=emb_rerank_mean_delta region=eu-west1 duration=00:12 threshold=-0.08 current=-0.21
suggested_action=auto_rollback target_version=v1.11.3 fallback_version=v1.10.7 impact=embeddings,reranker jobs

tom: oncall — i'm seeing the same in offline evals: top-1 drop, likely due to new quantization profile in v1.11.3 combined with narrower beam settings. not seeing infrastructure errors.

priya: given that a subset of big customers are on Dedicated pools pinned to v1.10.7, we should avoid an immediate global auto-rollback that would disrupt ongoing uploads. propose a surgical manual unwind: 1) pin dedicated pools (if not already) 2) rollback hosted slices for public traffic 3) hold canary and internal evals for patch.

lisa: +1. also we need a short customer-facing blurb for release notes and an internal incident note. cs_lead — can you own the customer comms?

cs_lead: I can. draft message to be short: "We observed a quality regression in embeddings after the recent model update in eu-west1. We've partially rolled back public traffic; dedicated customers remain on the prior version. We're investigating and will update in 30 minutes." will post to #customer-facing-updates once we confirm slice move.

ops_bot: INCIDENT CREATED incident-5799 severity=low owners=lisa,tom tags=embeddings,eu-west1

sre-oncall: if we're doing partial hosted rollback, remember to run the preflight pin for dedicated pools to avoid accidental drift. command below.

```
redwoodctl pools pin --pool-id=dedicated-eu-42 --model v1.10.7 --reason="prevent drift during embeddings rollback"
```
I'll run it now.

tom: executing hosted slice rollback: shifting slice slice-eu-9 from v1.11.3 -> v1.10.7 for 30% traffic. command:

```
routerctl traffic shift --slice slice-eu-9 --from v1.11.3 --to v1.10.7 --percent 30 --region eu-west1
```
Will monitor rerank score heatmap and DQ signals.

lisa: good. priya, after metrics stabilize, do a short postmortem entry in the release notes repo indicating root cause hypothesis (quantization+beam mismatch) and next steps (rebuild quant profile, run larger offline evals). Add an ETA for a patch (T+6h).

priya: ack. i'll create a short TODO in the release-notes repo and link the PR once ready. also adding a temporary guard in the deployment config to block auto-rollback for quality-only regressions where dedicated pools exist.

deploybot: ACTION: auto_rollback suppressed (policy=manual_override) by lisa.

cs_lead: message posted to #customer-facing-updates with note and ETA. tagged the impacted account leads.

ops_bot: TASK LOGGED: follow-up check in 30m. owners=tom,priay.

tom: after 8m metrics — public rerank mean recovered to within -0.03; embeddings downstream usage rates normalizing. holding manual rollback state for 40m then reconvene.

sre-oncall: dedicated pool pinned successfully. no unexpected rebalances.

lisa: thanks all. outcome: manual surgical rollback applied to hosted public slices, dedicated pools pinned, customer comms sent, auto-rollback disabled for this class of regression. we'll update release notes and schedule a quant rebuild. keeping this thread open until patch lands. :white_check_mark:
